base: benchmark/archive/scope_536_v1.csv (the 536-task set the HRI 2026 paper was scored on)
description: Adjudicated corrections from the September 2026 question audit and the full audit of all 536 tasks. 'keep' entries were examined and confirmed sound; they change nothing and are recorded so the audit is complete. Every full-audit entry names its source: Maintainer decision, or the rule it follows (R1-R11 in docs/JUDGING.md). It records, for every v2 change, the paper-set text it replaced and why.

judging_criteria.rule: Grade only the claim the question asks for. Wrong volunteered extras (for example a count offered alongside a correct comparison) no longer count against the answer.

Open descriptions accept any fair, grounded description of the scene, not one reference phrasing. 'Also accept:' in an expected answer lists alternates. Not applied to ocr_identification (stays exact) or location_spatial (stays tight).
'Also accept: X; Y' in an expected answer lists alternates, each correct on its own. Alternates never widen a count or a text reading beyond what they state, and grounding still applies.
